incident.reported_symptom: No Telegram production-cycle notification after parked PRODSEED000031 status; Hermes appeared stalled.
incident.cron_output_truth: The 12:00, 15:00 and 18:00 UTC durable outputs were silent/empty, so the scheduler had no payload to deliver.
incident.telegram_network_history: Gateway recorded Telegram network recovery errors earlier on 2026-09-05, but an explicit current diagnostic send succeeded.
incident.root_cause: production_runtime_tick.py intentionally suppressed all IDLE stdout; after the eligible U1 validated seed pool was exhausted, healthy cron runs became silent and looked stalled.

fix.behavior: Every deterministic tick emits JSON. IDLE results include PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_IDLE heartbeat, observed_at, provider_call_performed=false and parked count where available. NO_ELIGIBLE_SEED additionally emits next_action=REPLENISH_APPROVED_U1_VALIDATED_SEED_POOL.
fix.fa121_note: FA-121 remains a separate READY 24-hour live-load task and is not silently grafted onto die-production-cycle-v1.

next: Run zero-provider idle tick and Hermes cron delivery probe.
Replenish approved U1 validated seed pool before normal production can create another seed.
Execute FA-202 before FA-121; FA-121 should be wired as its own bounded stability canary after router/runtime readiness.
